title.ja: 有名人を悪用した暗号資産投資詐欺

short_desc.ja: SNS に有名人画像で広告を出し、偽の暗号資産投資サイトへ誘導
short_desc.en: Celeb-image ads on social media funnel into fake crypto platforms.

cultural_lever.ja: 著名人への親しみと、SNS 広告が規制されているという錯覚
cultural_lever.en: Trust in celebrities and perceived safety of social ads

scenario.ja: 1) SNS や検索結果で有名人画像の投資広告 2) 専門的な見かけのサイトへ誘導 3) 価格・運用成績を偽装 4) 入金後にアカウント凍結・連絡途絶
scenario.en: 1) Ads with celebrity images on social or search 2) Pro-looking site 3) Fake prices and returns 4) Account closed after deposit

ja: 有名人の推奨をうたう広告
急かされ投資を迫られる
FCA の FS Register で業者を照合
暗号資産は FSCS や Ombudsman で保護されないと認識
SNS広告のリンクを踏まない
en: Check firms on FCA FS Register
Know crypto is not covered by FSCS or FOS

legal_notes.ja: 英国の暗号関連は多くが規制外。FCA へ 0800 111 6768 で報告
legal_notes.en: Most crypto activity is unregulated in UK; report to FCA

references.label: FCA: Crypto investment scams
references.quote: Fraudsters tend to advertise on social media, often using images of celebrities to promote the fake investments. ... The scam adverts often link to professional-looking websites, where fraudsters may manipulate software to fake prices and investment returns. Once you’ve invested, the scammers may act quickly, closing your account and taking your money.

verification.note: FCA が接触経路（social media ads with celebrity images）と結果（closing your account and taking your money）を具体的に記述。英国で暗号は規制外のため損失保護がなく risk_score=4
